summary.text: Barry Finegold is a Democratic state senator representing the 2nd Essex and Middlesex District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Ballotpedia lists earlier service in the State Senate from 2011 to 2015 and in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 1997 to 2011; he took his current seat on January 2, 2019.

paragraphs.text: Barry Finegold earned a bachelor's degree from Franklin and Marshall College in 1993 and a law degree from the Massachusetts School of Law, Andover, in 1998.
His professional experience includes working as an attorney with Dalton & Finegold.

Finegold represented the 17th Essex District in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 1997 to 2011 and served in the State Senate from 2011 to 2015, returning to the Senate on January 2, 2019.
In the 2025-2026 session he chaired the Joint Committee on Economic Development and Emerging Technologies and was vice chair of the Intergovernmental Affairs Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
